servinfo.title: Parking sensor system does not work normally

attention3.ptxt: Parking sensor system is controlled by sonar control module communicating with the following control modules through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.

condition.ptxt: Parking sensor system does not work normally

ps.ptxt: Parking sensor system is not in execution state
Peripheral condition of vehicle is not appropriate to recognize obstacle by parking sensor
Obstacles difficult to recognize by parking sensor

action.ptxt: Unload the vehicle, remove modification parts for vehicle’s height, rear bumper, etc. and replace with genuine parts.
